entries.5a330a75e4412efa: This business manufactures and sells art and craft objects, such as precious-metal ornaments, Buddhist statues and Buddhist altar fittings. Using advanced casting techniques and meticulous finishing, it creates high-value-added products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥558 million.
entries.72fffec3810ae2ef: A company that collects and processes recycled non-ferrous metal materials, mainly copper, and manufactures and sells copper alloy ingots and art and craft products.
entries.75b4977d995560c2: This business purchases and sells products such as wrought copper products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥230 million.
entries.c80e09da17172726: This business blends and melts recycled copper and copper alloy raw materials collected from domestic and overseas sources, producing approximately 50 varieties of products in shapes and weights tailored to customers' needs and applications. The main varieties are aluminum bronze, used as raw material for ship propellers, and bronze, lead-free bronze and brass for the housing industry, such as faucet fittings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥35,548 million.
entries.d3ebc31d53daecab: This business processes approximately 150 varieties of non-ferrous metal recycled raw materials collected from domestic and overseas suppliers, through sorting, pressing and other methods, and sells them to electric wire manufacturers, copper smelting manufacturers and others. They are also used as melting materials for the company's own ingot production. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥46,125 million.
entries.d5c457c25f5df7cb: This business centers on copper and other nonferrous metal-related operations. It has two pillars: manufacturing and sales of ingots, and processing and sales of recycled raw materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥81,905 million.
